ubi diutius vixit, quamplurima scripsit, Discipu-

page.notes: Long s is printed as f in the running head ("fana"); transcribed as "sana". "Minifte:" at the line end is doubtful; transcribed as "Minist[?]e:". The small mark "73" at the bottom left, under the last line, is probably a gathering or folio mark and is left out. The strip of letters at the far right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out. The text reads "Adverfarios" and "Parifienfem" in the print; transcribed with plain s as "Adversarios" and "Parisiensem".
